title: Accidental Death Rider Rates by Anniversary Age: Term Life Insurance Installment Newly Due in Grace
content:
**Rider rate table — Term Life Insurance.** In the newly due installment counted in a grace remittance, the accidental death rider rate per 1,000 of rider amount is set by the insured's anniversary age, the whole years from the insured's date of birth to the most recent policy anniversary on or before today.

| Anniversary age | Rate per 1,000 |
|---|---|
| below 45 | 0.84 |
| 45 through 59 | the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000 |
| 60 through 69 (60 or more and below 70) | 1.08 |
| 70 or more | the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000 |

**Input - judgement - output (hypothetical).** Date of birth 15 October 1962; policy anniversary 1 March; today 20 September 2026. The most recent anniversary on or before today is 1 March 2026, when the insured was 63 — rate 1.08. An insured aged 44 at the most recent anniversary — rate 0.84. An insured aged 59 at the most recent anniversary — the product's rate.

The anniversary age is measured at the most recent policy anniversary, not at the insured's latest birthday: an insured who turned 60 after the most recent anniversary is still 59 for this table.
